title: Stop Saying These 7 Words Immediately
caption: Words change how people feel about buying. These 7 swaps work everywhere. Comment 'MOVE' and follow for the full list.
tips: Reply to EVERY comment in the first hour - it doubles the algorithm push.
Post at evening local time (19:00-21:00) for max initial engagement.
Pin your own comment with the direct link + a question.
thumbnail: Split screen: red X words vs green check words, big bold '7 WORDS' in the middle.
script:
[HOOK] 5 words to never say in AI copywriting.
[PAIRS - rapid fire]
Don't say game-changer, instead say turns things around - because people cliche alerts.
Don't say leverage, instead say apply - leveraged is AI-slop.
Don't say delve, instead say dig into - nobody says delve.
Don't say in today's world, instead say right now - timeless.
Don't say empower, instead say help - empower is corporate noise.
[CLOSE] Your AI copywriting does not have to sound like everyone else's. Comment 'MOVE' and I will send you the full list.
Make sure you follow - it only goes to followers.
